settings.title: Drive Energy Doc: settings
settings.description: Applies to all vehicles. The Companion app channel needs no account, Telegram needs a bot, WhatsApp a Meta business account. Afterwards add vehicles (add the integration again).

data.channels: How should Drive Energy Doc talk to you?
data.electric_price: Electricity price €/kWh (EV only, number or entity)
data.ai_task_entity: AI for reading receipts (empty = Gemini automatically)

price_key.title: Tankerkoenig
price_key.description: For prices in Germany. Free key at creativecommons.tankerkoenig.de, or leave empty (the receipt is enough).

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Cloud API
whatsapp.description: Credentials from the Meta developer portal, see README. Webhook address: /api/drive_energy_doc/whatsapp

data.wa_template: Template name (WhatsApp template with one variable, for messages after 24 h)

vehicle.title: Add vehicle

data.name: Name
data.phev: Plug-in hybrid (car both refuels and plugs in)

phev.title: Plug-in hybrid
phev.description: Plug-in hybrids only: battery level (%) so charging is detected, and battery size in kWh. Both are optional; without a sensor you log charging by receipt, photo or by hand.

plate_preview.title: Check the plate

data.ok: Fits, save (untick to go back and change it)

messaging_companion.title: Companion app
messaging_companion.description: Push message to your phone, a tap opens the panel.

data.push_detect: Push when refuelling is detected and when a receipt is missing
data.quick_link: Push link: a tap opens the photo capture (camera) directly

messaging_telegram.title: Telegram
messaging_telegram.description: Own bot or own chat per vehicle.

data.telegram_chat_id: Your chat ID (not the bot's: send /start to the bot, it tells you)
data.telegram_detect: Message when refuelling is detected and when a receipt is missing

messaging_whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
messaging_whatsapp.description: The driver's number. The access data is in the settings.

data.wa_phone: Driver's mobile number (with country code, e.g. 491701234567)
data.whatsapp_detect: Message when refuelling is detected and when a receipt is missing
